source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 2,900 full-time employees.

payroll.label: Our median employee's annual total compensation for 2025

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: Mr. Tenev's annual total compensation for 2025 was $3,004,978, as reported in the Summary Compensation Table included in this proxy statement. • Our median employee's annual total compensation for 2025 was $194,162.

notes: Employees: the 10-K's approximate year-end count; the proxy's pay-ratio section gives the exact figure of 2,958 regular full-time employees at December 31, 2025. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used (same year; identified by total direct compensation including the accounting value of 2025 equity awards).
